Gecko-Inspired Material FTIR Measurement

Experimental work involving FTIR-based measurement of contact area for a gecko-inspired material.

Project overview

This project investigates the use of a measurement setup based on frustrated total internal reflection (FTIR) to observe contact between a gecko-inspired material and a transparent surface.

Engineering activities

  • Work with an FTIR-based experimental measurement approach.
  • Capture images of the contact interface.
  • Explore image processing to identify and measure the contact area.
